The '''battle of Miztoc City''' was fought on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Miztoc]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] member [[Argon Doehn]] fought in the battle, and vital assistance was offered by [[Mygo Skinto]] which led to Miztoc remaining out of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] control.<ref name="CRO-" />
